free_tier.notes: No byte or title count is published on the site; 1,541 is the GitHub repository count, which includes non-book tooling repos.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: one EPUB/AZW3/KEPUB per book; the measured EPUB is 831,959 bytes

retention.stated: permanent: a curated public-domain catalogue, each book also held as a public git repository

egress.terms: Per-book downloads are free and unmetered. Bulk ZIPs of whole collections are not: 'Access to our bulk downloads is a benefit of Patrons circle membership', a paid donation tier. The Atom feed at /feeds/atom/all answered 401 to an anonymous client on 2026-10-23.
egress.free_allowance: no byte allowance published; bulk ZIPs are paywalled, per-book files are not

interface_detail: HTTPS per book, and a two-hop download: /ebooks/<author>/<title>/downloads/<file>.epub returns an HTML 'Your Download Has Started!' page carrying a meta refresh to the same path with ?source=download, which is the actual file. Each title is also a public git repository under github.com/standardebooks.
tooling: git clone of the per-book repository is the only bulk path that needs no donation; wget/curl with the two-hop pattern works per book.
chaining: Small, high-quality text corpus to pair with Gutenberg's 2.44 TB when typography matters; the git repos give clean XHTML source that a diff pipeline can track.

limits.value: bulk ZIPs are restricted to Patrons Circle members; no anonymous bulk endpoint exists

limits_note: The paywall on bulk ZIPs is a membership gate, not one of the seven vocabulary kinds: it is a purchase, not a rate, a quota or an identity check. The Atom feed also refused an anonymous client with 401, so feed-based crawling is closed.
binding_note: Nothing in the vocabulary fails at 1 TiB/month because the catalogue is far smaller than that: roughly 1,500 books at about 1 MB each is under 2 GB. The ceiling is corpus size, not service policy.

identity_cost.detail: No account for per-book downloads or for git clone. A Patrons Circle membership (paid) is the only registration-like gate, and it buys the bulk ZIPs only.

reliability_note: The direct .epub URL silently returns 200 with an HTML redirect page instead of the file; a client that trusts the status code saves a 8,777-byte web page as a book. The ?source=download hop is required.
confidence_note: The per-book EPUB was downloaded and hashed here; the paywall and the 401 on the feed were observed. Catalogue size is the one soft number - the 1,541 repository count is a proxy, not a title count.

evidence.proved: 'Access to our bulk downloads is a benefit of Patrons circle membership' - ZIP bulk is a paid tier
